decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and still shown on its own page, so its market value is unresolved, and keeping a compact dumper that fits the firm's core construction-equipment line costs little, so the option stays open.
The articulated dumper is a natural extension of the firm's dumper expertise with only one year of exposure, so it is too early to judge and cheap to keep as an option.

The underground mine rescue vehicle targets a small, project-driven niche whose value will take longer to show, and since the evidence so far gives no signal of failure it is kept, though with somewhat higher risk.
The compact telescopic loader faces stronger competition, but with only one year on the market and active presentation it has not revealed enough to justify abandoning it.
